title: The ste-push check leaves out a `cd` inside a subshell when it finds a push's folder
why: hooks/guard_push_delete.py push_target reads the last `cd` of the whole call, so `(cd M) && git push` takes "M)" as the push's folder, and ste-push skips that push with no note (lane lint-before-record-push, 04:42 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: push_target leaves out a `cd` inside a subshell, using the guard's existing shell tokenizer. Red case first. Related: step ste-push-segment-top-c-then-cd, same lane. Queue fix (owner item 386). Slug and lane from the coordinator (04:41 CST Nov 8). Filed 04:44 CST Nov 8. Now rides in PR #1898 with step ste-push-segment-top-c-then-cd, because the same `(cd A)` cases need both fixes; its own branch is abandoned (lane, 04:48 CST Nov 8).
